full.label: Sign-in and roles
full.detail: Accounts, and a page only admins see
full.prompt: A small app that shows sign-in: sign-up and sign-in pages, a profile page each user can edit, and a page only admins can open that lists every user. Then show me the tables and endpoints you made.

full.label: Database and API
full.detail: A table, its endpoints and a page that uses them
full.prompt: A small app that shows a database and its API: a books table with a few sample rows, endpoints to list, search, add, change and delete books, and a page that uses each one. Then walk me through the endpoints.

full.label: AI agent with a tool
full.detail: Chat with an agent that reads your data
full.prompt: A small app that shows a Xano AI agent: a products table with sample rows, an agent with a tool to search it, and a chat page where I ask what is in stock. Then show me the agent's instructions and its tool.

full.label: Scheduled task
full.detail: Something that runs every minute
full.prompt: A small app that shows scheduled tasks: every minute a task saves the time and a random number in a table, and a page charts the last hour. Then show me where the task is written.

full.label: Webhooks
full.detail: An address other systems can send to
full.prompt: A small app that shows webhooks: an endpoint that saves whatever is sent to it, a page that lists what arrived with the newest first, and a command I can run to send it a test.

full.label: File uploads
full.detail: Upload a picture, see a gallery
full.prompt: A small app that shows file uploads: a page to upload a picture with a caption, a gallery of everything uploaded, and a way to delete one.

full.label: SaaS starter
full.detail: Teams, roles and billing
full.prompt: A SaaS app where each customer is a team: sign-up, inviting teammates as admins or members, each team sees only its own data, monthly plans paid with Stripe, and a settings page for the team and its billing.

full.label: Marketplace
full.detail: Sellers list, buyers order
full.prompt: A marketplace with two kinds of account: sellers list items with photos and a price, buyers search and order them, each seller sees only their own orders, and an admin approves new sellers.

full.label: Online shop
full.detail: Products, a cart and checkout
full.prompt: An online shop for my business: products with photos, prices and stock, a cart, checkout that takes card payments with Stripe, an order confirmation email, and a page where I see new orders and mark them shipped.

full.label: Community app
full.detail: Posts, comments and a feed
full.prompt: A community app: sign-up with a profile and photo, posts people can like and comment on, following other people, a feed of the latest posts from people you follow, and a way to report a post to moderators.

full.label: Client portal
full.detail: Clients see their projects and invoices
full.prompt: A client portal for my agency: each client signs in and sees only their own projects, files and invoices, and my team updates each project's status and uploads deliverables.

full.label: Appointment booking
full.detail: Customers book, staff see their day
full.prompt: An appointment booking app for my business: services with a length and price, staff availability, bookings that never double-book, a reminder email the day before, and a daily schedule for each staff member.

full.label: Sales CRM
full.detail: Leads, deals and follow-ups
full.prompt: A CRM for my sales team: contacts and companies, deals that move through stages, notes on each one, a list of who to follow up with this week, and a pipeline total by stage.

full.label: Inventory and orders
full.detail: Stock, orders and low-stock alerts
full.prompt: An inventory app for my shop: products with stock levels, orders that reduce stock, and an email every morning listing anything that is running low.

full.label: Expense approvals
full.detail: Your team submits, managers approve
full.prompt: An internal tool for my team's expenses: people submit an expense with a receipt photo, their manager approves or rejects it with a note, and finance sees a monthly total by person.

full.label: Task board
full.detail: Who is doing what, and what is late
full.prompt: A task board for my team: projects with tasks, who owns each task and when it is due, columns for to do, doing and done that I can drag tasks between, and a page of everything that is overdue.

full.label: Admin panel
full.detail: Search, edit and audit your data
full.prompt: An admin panel for my product's data: tables of users and orders I can search, filter and edit, roles for who can change what, and a log of every change with who made it and when.

full.label: AI support desk
full.detail: Tickets, answered from your help articles
full.prompt: A support desk for my business: customers open tickets, an AI agent drafts an answer from my help articles, my team approves or edits it before it is sent, and hard tickets are assigned to a person.

full.label: Ask your documents
full.detail: Answers from your own files
full.prompt: An app where my team asks questions about our company documents: I add our policies and guides, an AI agent answers from them in a chat and says which document each answer came from, and I see the questions it could not answer.

full.label: Lead scoring
full.detail: AI rates each new lead with a reason
full.prompt: A lead tracker for my business: a sign-up form saves new leads, an AI agent reads each one and rates it hot, warm or cold with a short reason, and my team sees the best leads first.

full.label: Meeting notes
full.detail: AI turns your notes into to-dos
full.prompt: A meeting notes app: I paste my notes, an AI agent pulls out the action items with who owns them and when they are due, and saves them as tasks my team can tick off.

full.label: Document reader
full.detail: AI reads invoices into rows
full.prompt: An app that reads my supplier invoices: I upload a PDF or photo, an AI agent reads the supplier, date, line items and total from it, I correct anything it got wrong, and the invoices are listed by supplier and month.

full.label: Billing dashboard
full.detail: Payments and subscriptions in one place
full.prompt: A billing dashboard: take Stripe webhooks, record each payment and subscription change, show every customer's current status, and flag failed payments for my team to follow up.

full.label: Status page
full.detail: Checks your services, shows what is down
full.prompt: A status page for my services: a scheduled task calls each service's health address every few minutes and records whether it answered and how fast, a public page shows what is up, and my team gets an email when something goes down.

full.label: Daily report
full.detail: A scheduled summary in your inbox
full.prompt: A reporting app: my other systems send each sale to an endpoint, a page charts sales by day and product, and every morning I get an email with yesterday's totals, top products and anything unusual.

full.label: Form inbox
full.detail: Every website form in one place
full.prompt: An inbox for the forms on my websites: an endpoint each form posts to, every entry saved and emailed to the right person, repeated spam turned away, and a page where my team searches entries and marks them handled.

full.label: Replace a spreadsheet
full.detail: A real app for data your team shares
full.prompt: An app to replace a spreadsheet my team shares. I will paste its columns and a few rows. Make a table for it, a page to search, add and edit rows, a record of who changed what, a CSV import for the old data, and sign-in for my team only.

full.label: Rebuild a desktop database
full.detail: Move an Access or FileMaker app to the web
full.prompt: Rebuild my old desktop database app as a web app. I will describe its tables, forms and reports. Start with the tables and the most used form, keep the same field names so I can import the old data, and add sign-in with roles.

full.label: One piece at a time
full.detail: Move one part of an old app first
full.prompt: Move one part of my old application to Xano and leave the rest running. I will describe that part, such as its customer records. Build its tables, its endpoints with the same request and response shapes the old app uses, and its screens, so I can switch that part over and then do the next.

full.label: Replace scheduled scripts
full.detail: Scheduled jobs you can see and trust
full.prompt: Replace the scheduled scripts my team runs on an old server. I will describe what each one does and when it runs. Rebuild each as a scheduled task with a log of every run, what it changed and whether it failed, a page showing the runs, and an email when one fails.

backend.label: Database and API
backend.detail: A table and the endpoints to use it
backend.prompt: A small backend that shows a database and its API: a books table with a few sample rows, and endpoints to list, search, add, change and delete books. Then show me how to call each one.

backend.label: Sign-in
backend.detail: Accounts and endpoints only they can call
backend.prompt: A small backend that shows sign-in: sign-up and sign-in endpoints, an endpoint that returns the signed-in user's profile, and one only admins can call that lists every user. Then show me how to call each one.

backend.label: Scheduled task
backend.detail: Something that runs every minute
backend.prompt: A small backend that shows scheduled tasks: every minute a task saves the time and a random number in a table, and an endpoint returns the last hour. Then show me where the task is written.

backend.label: Webhooks
backend.detail: An address other systems can send to
backend.prompt: A small backend that shows webhooks: an endpoint that saves whatever is sent to it, another that lists what arrived with the newest first, and a command I can run to send it a test.

backend.label: Mobile app backend
backend.detail: Sign-in, profiles and a feed
backend.prompt: The backend for my mobile app: sign-up and sign-in, user profiles with photos, posts people can like and comment on, and a feed of the latest posts from people they follow.

backend.label: SaaS backend
backend.detail: Teams, roles and data kept apart
backend.prompt: The backend for my SaaS product: sign-up and sign-in, teams with admin and member roles, invitations by email, every table scoped so a team reads only its own rows, and endpoints for my frontend to manage the team.

backend.label: Customer accounts
backend.detail: Sign-up, sign-in and profiles
backend.prompt: Customer accounts for my existing website: sign-up with email confirmation, sign-in, a forgotten-password email, and a profile each customer can read and change but nobody else can.

backend.label: Shop backend
backend.detail: Products, carts and orders
backend.prompt: The backend for my online shop: products with prices and stock, a cart for each customer, checkout that makes an order and reduces stock, and endpoints for my website to list products and show a customer's orders.

backend.label: Booking API
backend.detail: Availability, bookings and reminders
backend.prompt: A booking API for my salon's existing website: services, staff availability, bookings that never double-book, and a reminder email the day before.

backend.label: Inventory API
backend.detail: Stock, orders and low-stock alerts
backend.prompt: An inventory API for my shop: products with stock levels, orders that reduce stock, and an alert when anything runs low.

backend.label: Admin API
backend.detail: Search, edit and audit your data
backend.prompt: An admin API for my product's data: endpoints to search, filter and edit users and orders, roles for who can change what, and a log of every change with who made it and when.

backend.label: Text summaries
backend.detail: Send text, get the short version
backend.prompt: A backend with an endpoint that takes a long piece of text, such as a customer email or a call transcript, and returns a short summary and a list of action items written by AI, and saves each one so I can read it later.

backend.label: Message sorting
backend.detail: AI tags each message by topic
backend.prompt: A backend that takes the messages my customers send: AI tags each one with a topic and how urgent it is, saves it, and an endpoint lists them with the most urgent first.

backend.label: Plain-words search
backend.detail: Customers describe it, AI finds it
backend.prompt: A product search backend for my shop: products with a name, description and price, and a search endpoint where customers describe what they want in plain words and AI returns the best matches.

backend.label: Website forms
backend.detail: Save every entry and email it to you
backend.prompt: A backend for the forms on my existing website: an endpoint that saves each contact or sign-up entry, emails it to me, turns away repeated spam, and lets me list and search the entries.

backend.label: Payments webhooks
backend.detail: Stripe events update your customers
backend.prompt: A backend that takes Stripe webhooks: record each payment, keep every customer's subscription status up to date, and flag failed payments for my team.

backend.label: Nightly reports
backend.detail: A scheduled summary in your inbox
backend.prompt: A backend that stores my team's sales and sends me an email every morning with yesterday's totals, top products and anything unusual.

backend.label: Data sync
backend.detail: Keep two systems in step
backend.prompt: A backend that keeps my CRM and my billing system in step: take webhooks from each, match customers by email, save one record for each customer with both systems' fields, and list the customers where the two disagree.

backend.label: Spreadsheet replacement
backend.detail: Your team's data, behind an API
backend.prompt: A backend to replace a spreadsheet my team shares: a table for each sheet, endpoints to add, change, search and export rows, a record of who changed what, and only people on my team can sign in.

backend.label: API for an old database
backend.detail: Modern endpoints over old tables
backend.prompt: A modern API in front of my old database. I will paste its table definitions. Make matching tables, clean REST endpoints with sign-in and paging, and an import so I can load the old data.

backend.label: One service at a time
backend.detail: Move one part of an old app first
backend.prompt: Move one service of my old application to Xano and leave the rest running. I will describe that service and paste its requests and responses. Build its tables and endpoints with the same request and response shapes, so the old app's callers work unchanged when I switch it over.

backend.label: Replace scheduled scripts
backend.detail: Scheduled jobs you can see and trust
backend.prompt: Replace the scheduled scripts my team runs on an old server. I will describe what each one does and when it runs. Rebuild each as a scheduled task with a log of every run, what it changed and whether it failed, an endpoint that lists the runs, and an email when one fails.

mcp.label: First MCP server
mcp.detail: Two tools to try from Claude
mcp.prompt: A small MCP server to try: one tool that returns the current time in a city I name and one that rolls dice. Then tell me how to connect it to Claude or ChatGPT and what to ask.

mcp.label: Notes MCP
mcp.detail: Save and find notes from a chat
mcp.prompt: A small notes backend with an MCP server: tools to save a note with tags, search my notes and fetch one. Then tell me how to connect it to Claude so I can try it.

mcp.label: API docs MCP
mcp.detail: AI coding tools read your API's docs
mcp.prompt: An MCP server for the developers who use my product: a table of my API's endpoints and guides, and tools to search them and fetch one, so AI coding assistants can answer questions about my API.

mcp.label: Account MCP
mcp.detail: Your users reach their data from an AI assistant
mcp.prompt: An MCP server for my product's users: each user signs in, and tools list, find and update only that user's own records, so they can work with their account from Claude or ChatGPT.

mcp.label: CRM MCP
mcp.detail: ChatGPT looks up and updates customers
mcp.prompt: A simple CRM with an MCP server: customers, companies and notes, with tools to find a customer, add a note and list who to follow up with this week.

mcp.label: Expenses MCP
mcp.detail: Log spending by chatting with Claude
mcp.prompt: An expense tracker used from Claude through an MCP server: tools to log an expense with a category, list this month's spending, and total it by category.

mcp.label: Tasks MCP
mcp.detail: Add and tick off to-dos from a chat
mcp.prompt: A to-do list for my team with an MCP server: tasks with an owner and a due date, and tools to add a task, list what is due this week and mark one done, so we can manage them from Claude or ChatGPT.

mcp.label: Stock MCP
mcp.detail: Ask an AI assistant what is in stock
mcp.prompt: An inventory backend for my shop with an MCP server: products with stock levels, and tools to check a product's stock, record a delivery and list what is running low, so I can ask an AI assistant instead of opening a spreadsheet.

mcp.label: Help center MCP
mcp.prompt: An MCP server for my help center: tools to search my help articles and fetch one, so Claude and ChatGPT can answer my customers' questions from them.

mcp.label: Booking MCP
mcp.prompt: An appointment booking backend with an MCP server: tools to check open slots, book one, and cancel, so AI assistants can book appointments for my customers.

mcp.label: Orders MCP
mcp.prompt: An orders backend with an MCP server: customers and orders, with tools to find an order, check its status and list what shipped this week, so AI assistants can answer my customers.

mcp.label: Product catalog MCP
mcp.detail: AI assistants find products and prices
mcp.prompt: A product catalog for my shop with an MCP server: products with a description, price and whether they are in stock, and tools to search them and fetch one, so AI assistants can recommend my products.

mcp.label: Old records MCP
mcp.detail: Ask an AI assistant about legacy data
mcp.prompt: An MCP server over the data from my old system. I will paste its table definitions. Make matching tables and an import, and read-only tools to search records and fetch one, so my team can ask Claude about the old data.

mcp.label: Old API MCP
mcp.detail: Give AI assistants tools for a legacy API
mcp.prompt: An MCP server in front of my old system's API. I will paste the requests it accepts. Make a tool for each one I name, which calls the old API and returns a clean result, and keep a log of every call.

agent.label: Agent with a tool
agent.detail: Chat with an agent that reads your data
agent.prompt: A small app that shows a Xano AI agent: a products table with sample rows, an agent with a tool to search it, and a chat page where I ask what is in stock. Then show me the agent's instructions and its tool.

agent.label: Agent that saves
agent.detail: Tell it something, it fills in a table
agent.prompt: A small app that shows a Xano AI agent changing data: I type what I spent in plain words, the agent saves each expense with an amount and a category, and a page lists them. Then show me the tool it uses to save.

agent.label: In-app assistant
agent.prompt: An assistant for my product's users: a Xano AI agent that answers a signed-in user's questions about their own account, with tools that read only that user's records, and a chat endpoint and page my app can use.

agent.label: Onboarding guide
agent.prompt: An onboarding guide for my product: a list of setup steps each new user should finish, and a Xano AI agent that sees which steps a user has done, answers their questions and suggests the next step, with a chat page.

agent.label: Orders assistant
agent.detail: Finds and updates orders when you ask
agent.prompt: An orders assistant for my shop: customers and orders tables, and a Xano AI agent with tools to find an order, check its status and mark it shipped, with a chat page where my team asks in plain words.

agent.label: Lead qualifier
agent.detail: Scores new sign-ups with a reason
agent.prompt: A lead tracker: a sign-up form saves new leads, and a Xano AI agent reads each one, rates it hot, warm or cold with a short reason, and saves that so my team sees the best leads first.

agent.label: Meeting notes
agent.prompt: A meeting notes app: I paste my notes, and a Xano AI agent pulls out the action items with who owns them and when they're due, and saves them as tasks I can tick off.

agent.label: Inbox sorter
agent.prompt: An inbox for my business's messages: each new message is saved, and a Xano AI agent tags it as a question, a complaint or an order and drafts a reply, with a page where my team edits and approves each reply.

agent.label: Weekly report
agent.detail: Your week's sales in plain words
agent.prompt: A sales log with a weekly report: my team records each sale, and every Monday a Xano AI agent reads last week's sales and writes a short summary of what sold, what did not and what changed, which I read on a reports page.

agent.label: Support agent
agent.prompt: An AI support agent for my shop: an FAQ table I can edit, and a Xano AI agent that answers customer questions from it, with a chat page where customers ask and a list of questions it couldn't answer.

agent.label: Booking assistant
agent.prompt: A booking assistant for my business: services and open time slots, and a Xano AI agent with tools to find a free slot, book it and cancel it, with a chat page where customers book in plain words and a page of today's bookings for my team.

agent.label: Product finder
agent.prompt: A product finder for my shop: a products table with descriptions and prices, and a Xano AI agent that asks a customer what they need and recommends products from it, with a chat page for customers.

agent.label: Old data clean-up
agent.detail: Fixes records as you bring them over
agent.prompt: A clean-up tool for data from my old system: I import the old customer records, and a Xano AI agent finds likely duplicates, fixes names and phone number formats, and lists what it would change for me to approve.

agent.label: Old system explainer
agent.prompt: A helper for my team while we replace an old system: I import its records and paste notes on what each field means, and a Xano AI agent answers questions about the old data in a chat page and says which records each answer came from.
